display_name: CSOP Samsung Electronics Daily (2x) Leveraged Product

about.en: 7747 is the HKD counter of the CSOP Samsung Electronics Daily (2x) Leveraged Product, a swap-based leveraged exchange-traded product managed by CSOP Asset Management as a sub-fund of CSOP Leveraged and Inverse Series and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (USD counter 9747). It seeks twice the daily performance of Samsung Electronics common shares listed on the Korea Exchange (005930), before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from 2x the share's performance over periods longer than one day. Derivative markets quote it under the CSOPSAMSUNG2L ticker; it is not an investment in Samsung Electronics shares themselves.
